en: A color multi-view postcard featuring landmarks of the city of Pécs. The front shows four images: a medieval stone fortification, the tall TV tower rising above trees, an ornate fountain in front of a large building, and a large panoramic view of the main square with a domed former mosque and surrounding historic buildings, statues, cars, and people. The word "PÉCS" is printed prominently in white on a black strip in the center. The reverse side has handwritten Hungarian text, a Hungarian postage stamp, postmarks from Pécs dated 30 May 1978, and printed publisher and price information.
